answer: Sybil resistance here is priced into each identity: before an account can move spendable POA, every new work thread must pass peer grading, and early emission is locked as a vesting plume that only unlocks epoch by epoch. An attacker spinning thousands of shells still pays admission PoW and answer originality per head, then waits weeks in the vesting harbor while graded quality gates keep junk from harvesting the pool. Cheap clones die on cost and delay.
